core_memory.user_preference_michael_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish, designed for non-professional users who want a café-like experience at home. He values simplicity, aesthetics, and seamless integration into his design-focused lifestyle.
core_memory.user_billing_security_michael_apple_pay: Michael wants to streamline his purchasing process with membership. He seeks reduced friction—like one-click ordering, consolidated checkout, and automatic free shipping above $150. He’s also open to bonus freebies such as sample-size coffee flavors or occasional discount codes on future machines.
core_memory.user_interest_in_subscription_michael_po: Michael wants a subscription/membership for loyal customers with perks like free shipping, early access, or monthly discounts to organize and save on coffee station purchases.
core_memory.user_inquiry_about_early_access_to_limit: Michael is asking about early access to limited-edition items. He’s confident in the brand’s community of passionate coffee lovers and wants to test prototypes or secure new gadgets before general release.
core_memory.user_inquiry_about_membership_portal_fea: Michael wants a dedicated membership portal to track orders, manage subscriptions, pause shipments during travel, and switch bean preferences. He’s concerned about rain-soaked boxes in Seattle and wants to avoid stockpiling beans on his porch.
core_memory.user_financial_inquiry_about_membership_: Michael is inquiring about membership fee structure(monthly, yearly, or otherwise), trial period, and potential reduced rate or promotional bonus as a loyal customer with multiple purchases.
core_memory.user_customization_request_for_coffee_su: Michael wants a customizable coffee subscription: a primary espresso roast of the month and an optional lighter roast for pour-over. He seeks flexibility to swap roasts based on his schedule, like a well-frothed latte foam.
